{{quote|It's terrible to watch, breakbone fever. The child was soaked with sweat, groaning and twisting until I could not understand why I didn't hear her bones snapping.|[[Nynaeve]] recounting [[Egwene]]'s childhood illness and the miraculous recovery.{{ref/book|1|21}}}}
'''Breakbone fever''' is a disease that breaks out from time to time. It is often deadly.

==Mentions==
[[Egwene al'Vere]] recalls that her sister [[Berowyn al'Vere]] lost her husband and infant child to breakbone fever and "told Egwene how
lucky, she felt that the fever had not taken her baby sister, too."{{ref/book|1|ravens}} This happened in fall of {{ne|990}}.{{ref|{{twotc|Berowyn al'Vere}}}}

Nynaeve recalls Egwene having breakbone fever when Nynaeve was "still young" and apprenticed to [[Doral Barran]], the [[Wisdom]] of [[Emond's Field]]. This was prompted by [[Moiraine Damodred]]'s inquiry about Nynaeve's first channeling event.{{ref/book|1|21}} From the above, it is likely to be in {{ne|990}}, when Egwene would have been 8 or 9 and Nynaeve was 15 or 16.

==Parallels==

Dengue fever is also known as break-bone fever due to the bone pain caused by the disease. It is caused by a mosquito borne virus, and is usually not lethal.{{ref|[http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmedhealth/PMH0002350/ PubMed Health - Dengue fever]}} However, Dengue hemorrhagic fever, which is caused by the same virus, can cause a patient to go into shock. Fifty percent of those patients will die.{{ref|[http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmedhealth/PMH0002349/ PubMed Health - Dengue hemorrhagic fever]}}
